home.title: No tenant negotiates alone.
home.lede: The co-operative owned by Singapore's frontline businesses: the shops, eateries and studios that keep our malls alive.

about.title: Tenants, united.
about.lede: SGTUFF is an advocate for local SME frontline businesses in retail, F&B and services, focusing on fair tenancy and manpower issues.

fairTenancy.title: A fair lease is not a favour.
fairTenancy.lede: The Code of Conduct for Leasing of Retail Premises sets the ground rules for retail leases in Singapore. We help tenants know it and use it.

membership.title: Pick how you join.
membership.lede: Every tier makes the co-op stronger. Already a member? Log in to the member portal.

tiers.name: Member
tiers.for: Any owner or operator of a retail, F&B or services business.
perks: Full Lease Health Check report and Tenant Playbook

tiers.name: Associate
tiers.for: Owners with a lease to protect.
perks: 1 lease review a year by a TUFF Lease Mentor
TUFF Rent Benchmarks: see what others pay
Discounted consult with our partner lawyers

tiers.name: Patron
tiers.for: Groups with three or more outlets.
perks: Mentor review on every renewal, across all your outlets
Your name on the Patrons wall

businessNetwork.title: Small alone. Big together.
businessNetwork.lede: The SGTUFF Business Network connects brick-and-mortar retailers, F&B operators and service providers.

news.title: What’s happening.
news.lede: Updates on fair tenancy, member benefits and retail movements.

collaborate.title: Let’s build fairer retail.
collaborate.lede: We work with government agencies, landlords, trade associations, media and technology providers.

contact.title: Talk to us.
contact.lede: Questions about your lease, membership or working with us? We’re here.
